configurations.name: surface-landing
runtimeArgs: pnpm turbo run build --output-logs=errors-only --filter=@stackra/cli... && node packages/developer/cli/dist/stackra.mjs build --product --surfaces-only && exec node packages/developer/cli/dist/stackra.mjs preview serve --surface landing --port 4173
